distinguishing_features: Electrochemical stabilization via existing CP infrastructure to maintain passive film
pH suppression through sacrificial anode potentials instead of chemical dosing
Leverages micro-galvanic corrosion physics for wear mitigation
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Mitigating corrosive-wear in seawater-lubricated bearings by electrochemically maintaining a passive surface film without material substitution or chemical injection
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism aligns with established electrochemical passivation principles and uses existing shipboard CP infrastructure within feasible current density ranges.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The integration of CP systems for localized pH/passivation control in bearing interfaces is not disclosed in prior art focused on chemical dosing or electrical impedance monitoring.
